answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The mesa lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the garden is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lotus of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
